profile.description:
Qwen3.8 Flash is Alibaba's fast multimodal Qwen3.8 model, built for coding, agent, and vision workloads. It accepts text, image, and video input with a 1M token context, and supports deep thinking, function calling, and structured JSON output.

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
